column3: #2649 closed: LocalStorage.CreateOrUpdateSecretACL now runs its upsert and a FOR SHARE re-read of the live secret node in one transaction and rolls back if the node is gone; DeleteSecret UPDATEs (locks) the secret row before its CWE-284 ACL cascade, so the cascade either sees the committed grant or the grant fails closed. The IsProjectMember read remains serial-equivalent. Proven: TestCTAReview_GrantSecretACL_vs_DeleteSecret_CrossReplicaPostgres, TestCTAReview_GrantSecretACL_DeleteSecretAfterUpsert_CrossReplicaPostgres, TestLocalACL_RefusesSoftDeletedSecret.
